left_decisions.question: Who is the legal operator (name, CUI, J number, address, contact/DPO email), is it the same entity as the invoice seller, and are the Terms, Privacy and firm-rules texts approved by a lawyer? Also: which vendors and data region should Privacy name, and must it mention that backups keep deleted data for 12 months?
left_decisions.default_now: Operator identity is hidden (legal_identity_published=false). Draft Terms (11 sections), Privacy (10) and /firm-rules ship built from docs facts, with generic processor wording ('EU-hosted provider', data may be outside the EEA). The legal version is not bumped.
left_decisions.blocks: Production launch: legal pages have no real identity, and the lawyer sign-off is an unchecked item in the CHANGELOG.

left_decisions.question: Which final domain and EU email provider (Brevo, Postmark EU or Amazon SES), which monitored SUPPORT_EMAIL mailbox, which emails carry Reply-To support, and what goes in security.txt?
left_decisions.default_now: The code is provider-agnostic and configured only through env. Production refuses to boot on Mailpit or other fake SMTP. Reply-To support is set only on auth, account and billing emails. security.txt uses the support email and expires 180 days after the build.
left_decisions.blocks: Any production deploy: both slots abort boot until real SMTP_*, MAIL_FROM and SUPPORT_EMAIL are set.

left_decisions.question: Which e-Factura route (provider API such as SmartBill/Oblio, direct ANAF SPV, or a monthly accountant export)? Storno or backfill for invoices already issued? How is a firm's VAT-payer status verified? Should bank-transfer orders get reminder and auto-cancel days?
left_decisions.default_now: Manual accountant route: per-order e-Factura status plus a monthly CSV export. No storno and no buyer_snapshot backfill (the SQL is ready in the CHANGELOG). VAT status is self-declared (an RO prefix sets it, and owners can toggle it). Bank-transfer reminder and expiry are both 0 (off). Stripe test keys are refused in prod unless a staging flag is set.
left_decisions.blocks: Taking real money: payments return 503 BILLING_NOT_CONFIGURED until real seller data is entered, and there is no automated SPV reporting.

left_decisions.question: Is the round-4 pricing final (Start 0 / Ofertare 299 / Prioritate 599, claim cost 3..25 credits, recurring billing)? Do credits expire 3 months after the subscription ends? How does a firm get a free plan, and what does it include? What should happen to a drifted wallet? Can the credit_cost column be dropped and docs/03 and docs/07 amended?
left_decisions.default_now: The three existing plans are unchanged and now stored as data. Claim cost min 1 with no cap. Credits never expire. Checkout stays one-off (30 days per purchase). A free plan is admin-grant only, with access chosen per plan. A drifted wallet skips settlement and alerts the admin. credit_cost is only made nullable, not dropped.
left_decisions.blocks: Launching the new pricing tiers and Ofertare Rapida plan features. docs/07 stays inconsistent with the code on claim cost.

left_decisions.question: Should a request stay claimable after the first offer while fewer than 3 firms have claimed it (option A, which amends invariant 3.1), or does the first offer close claims (option B)?
left_decisions.default_now: Option A is built behind claims_open_after_first_offer=false, so today's rule applies: the first offer closes claims. /firm-rules states whichever rule is active.
left_decisions.blocks: The 'three competing offers' goal. Enabling it also needs an invariant 3.1 amendment and a docs/07 entry.

left_decisions.question: When a project is cancelled after acceptance, are the winner's credits refunded or consumed? Does a mutual cancel close automatically? After how many days are expired, undecided offers auto-closed, and with what outcome and penalty? Should firms get an 'Am început execuția' action?
left_decisions.default_now: Only an admin closes a project, choosing REFUND or CONSUME explicitly with a note. Mutual confirmation just notifies the admins. Auto-close of expired offers is built but OFF (14-day placeholder). No penalty at expiry. No IN_EXECUTION action.
left_decisions.blocks: Automatic unsticking of stalled projects: every case needs manual admin work.

left_decisions.question: Firm-side rules: who may withdraw or mark delivered (only owner/manager?), when do firms see client contacts (on claim or after the 30-minute grace), how long after completion do they keep seeing them, what limits apply to the 48h and 'request modified' refunds, a fresh re-quote window after an offer is withdrawn, and can a firm cancel its own pending withdrawal?
left_decisions.default_now: Withdraw and deliver: OWNER/MANAGER, plus the claimer or assignee within the 30-minute grace. Contacts ON_CLAIM, retention 0 (no cutoff). The 48h refund needs a firm message with 48h of client silence. A 'modified' refund works only until the firm sends an offer. Withdrawing an offer re-arms the original SLA. No self-cancel of a pending withdrawal.
left_decisions.blocks: The docs/07 entry for the contact and refund rule (E-company-3 done_when stays open). Stricter settings are already switchable in Admin.

left_decisions.question: Client privacy and request-flow knobs: should contacts typed in text be masked or block publishing? Should distance show as km or bands? Minimum firm radius 2 or 5 km, and location caps per plan? Are inspiration notes visible pre-claim? Does a note edit consume an edit? A public collection share link? Default budget bucket without an estimate? Wipe Studio scenes on logout? Edit or duplicate an expired request?
left_decisions.default_now: MASK, KM, 2 km radius, 10 locations and 20 changes per day. Masked notes are shown pre-claim. A note edit consumes an edit. No share link. UNDER_5K stays the default. Studio scenes are kept on logout. An expired request that was already reposted links to a new request.
left_decisions.blocks: Nothing hard: all defaults are live and most are Admin settings. It only confirms the product stance.

left_decisions.question: Should offers carry a with/without-VAT flag and payment terms, can clients accept an older offer version, and should accept be blocked while their own change request is pending?
left_decisions.default_now: No new offer fields; the accept dialog shows a neutral VAT hint. Only the latest version can be accepted (409 QUOTE_VERSION_CHANGED otherwise). Accept is allowed while a change request is pending.
left_decisions.blocks: A richer offer model. docs/03 4.13 ('any existing variant') is not fully honoured.

left_decisions.question: Which vendors for off-site EU backups, the error tracker (Sentry EU or GlitchTip), cookieless analytics (Umami or Plausible), uptime monitor and dead-man switch? Who receives backup reports and holds key escrow? Should uploads stay on MinIO? What RTO? Is an admin ops panel for queues wanted?
left_decisions.default_now: Everything is env-driven and OFF until configured. Backups go to any S3 endpoint through rclone. RPO 24h, RTO 'proposed 4h'. MinIO stays (decision 8). Log retention follows the Railway plan. No ops panel is built.
left_decisions.blocks: Real backups, alerting and analytics in production: none run until vendors and accounts exist.

left_decisions.question: Production perimeter: remove the public Railway slot domains, which header carries the real client IP, keep the Redis throttler (+150 ms cross-region) or use memory until the EU migration, allowlist inspiration image hosts, pay for GitHub branch protection, and turn on secret scanning?
left_decisions.default_now: Health is status-only with a token for details, and noindex applies on non-canonical hosts. TRUSTED_CLIENT_IP_HEADER is unset (req.ip as before). THROTTLER_STORE=redis with memory fallback. CSP img-src is narrowed only when the storage origin build arg is set. The CI gate plus require-green-ci replaces branch protection. CodeQL is added.
left_decisions.blocks: Full rate-limit accuracy and closing the old slot URLs. verify-slot fails releases until the IP header is set, unless run with --rate-limit-check off.

left_decisions.question: Rubber-stamp the small defaults: admin login lockout after 5 attempts (reveals admin accounts), admins exempt from re-accepting Terms, legal gate UI-only, suspended firms losing access to ongoing projects, the bridge-days wording, and Sprint 75 design choices (mono badges, 20px section heading, mm_session role hint, Studio hex left for later)?
left_decisions.default_now: All implemented as described. Each is a one-line or one-constant change if the PO disagrees.
left_decisions.blocks: Nothing. These only need a yes/no.
